mechanism: Probenecid inhibits the renal tubular secretion of empagliflozin via URAT1 and other organic anion transporters, potentially increasing empagliflozin plasma concentrations and reducing urinary glucose excretion efficacy.
action: Monitor renal function and glycemic control closely; consider alternative uricosuric agents or adjust empagliflozin dosing if probenecid is necessary; assess for reduced SGLT2 inhibitor efficacy.
